title: Berry Watermelon 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid by Seriously Slushy
description:
Seriously Slushy Berry Watermelon 100ml Shortfill is a sweet and juicy blend with a slushie finish. The mixed berries contrast between sweet and tart while the watermelon offers a crisp and clean base note. Finished with an icy slush.
Seriously Slushy Shortfills are brought to you by the team at justvapesaustralia . Supplied in a 120ml shortfill bottle, containing 100ml of zero nicotine e-liquid. Simply mix in two 18mg nicotine shots to create an overall 3mg strength.
